interpretation_limits: All model inputs are explicitly simulated; the 1296 ha UTM square is not the actual regional Upper Savannah watershed.
Exact support differs across routing methods and between MFD nutrients and sediment; do not combine rows into a single pooled mask or probabilistic interval.
The report's coverage_complete flag does not establish coverage of every reporting-area cell.
Slope-cap pairs are identical output cases, not independent samples; only a small deterministic factorial was explored.
Same area and original land-cover class mix are controlled; no cost, feasibility, observed calibration, treatment or intake-concentration result is provided.
Native original numeric report uses renderer_version 4; later renderer improvements do not alter this retained source.
